evidence.curator_note: Eq 8.16, p.149. GENERIC scheme (R undefined; no m/z or % printed). Same beta-hydroxy-ketone molecular ion and same enol product ion as branch (a); the book draws '+.' on the carbonyl O and on the enol product O ('H-O+.'), so charge and odd electron stay localized on that oxygen (conventions B, C). This record is branch (b): the competing CLASSIC McLafferty transfer of a gamma C-H (a hydrogen of the terminal methyl, map 8 on C7) rather than the hydroxyl H. It yields the ENOL neutral vinyl alcohol (CH2=CHOH, dHf -1.3 eV printed under it, the 'or' product), which is less stable than the keto tautomer formed in branch (a); the text notes the keto path (branch a) is favored. Six-membered TS [O2=C1-C4-C5-C7-H8] delivers the gamma C-H to the carbonyl O, the Calpha-Cbeta bond (C4-C5) cleaves, and C5=C7 forms (giving the enol vinyl alcohol on the neutral, the carbinol OH being retained). ARC COUNT: the book draws 0 electron arc(s) -- only the 'rH' label and the six-membered TS geometry are printed; NO curved arrows/fishhooks appear. The three encoded moves are the complete balanced flow implied by 'rH', written as a concerted 6-electron retro-ene: move <1> C7-H8 sigma -> forming O2-H8 bond; move <2> C1=O2 pi -> forming enol C1=C4 pi; move <3> C4-C5 sigma -> forming C5=C7 pi. In this O-localized resonance form the +. radical is a spectator on O2 (no per-atom radical change), matching the drawn '+.' on the enol oxygen; a stepwise fishhook drawing with a migrating radical is an alternative. Instantiated R = CH3 (4-hydroxypentan-2-one, M+. = C5H10O2, m/z 102.0675); enol ion CH3-C(O+.H)=CH2 (C3H6O+., computed m/z 58.0413) -- curator instantiation value, not a book number.

This classic McLafferty gamma-C-H rearrangement has no cross-linked Rule.fromDFS encoding, so the electron flow is curator-derived from the printed scheme and is NOT verified against any MOD rule.
